items.title: zai-org/GLM-5
items.summary: GLM-5.2 是 ZAI 最新旗舰模型，首次在 1M token 上下文上稳定支持长程任务，提出 IndexShare 架构（每四层共享索引器）将每 token FLOPs 降低 2.9 倍，并改进 MTP 推测解码层使接受长度提升最高 20%。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上达到 81.0 分（GLM-5.1 为 62.0），接近 Claude Opus 4.8 的 85.0，领先 Gemini 3.1 Pro，为当前最强开源模型。GLM-5 系列从 GLM-4.5 的 355B 参数（32B 活跃）扩展至 744B（40B 活跃），预训练数据从 23T 增至 28.5T tokens，集成 DeepSeek Sparse Attention 降低部署成本，并采用自研异步 RL 训练框架 slime 提升训练效率。
items.why_now: GLM-5.2刚发布，支持1M上下文且API已上线，性能逼近Claude Opus 4.8。
items.summary_en: GLM-5.2, Z.ai's latest flagship model, features a 1M-token context using IndexShare architecture that reduces per-token FLOPs by 2.9×, while improving MTP-based speculative decoding acceptance by 20%. It achieves 81.0 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 62.1 on SWE-bench Pro, outperforming Gemini 3.1 Pro and nearing Claude Opus 4.8 (85.0). The GLM-5 series scales to 744B parameters (40B active) with DeepSeek Sparse Attention infrastructure and slime asynchronous RL training framework, targeting complex long-horizon agentic engineering tasks.

items.title: withastro/flue
items.summary: Flue 是 withastro 开发的 Agent Harness 框架，提供基于 TypeScript 的可编程沙盒环境，用于构建自主 AI Agent 和工作流。框架内置会话管理、工具调用、技能加载、安全沙盒、持久化执行、子代理委派等核心能力，支持通过 MCP 协议连接外部服务，并兼容 OpenTelemetry、Braintrust、Sentry 等可观测性方案。开发者可通过 CLI 本地运行或部署至 Node.js、Cloudflare Workers、GitHub Actions、GitLab CI/CD、Daytona、Render 等平台，使用 `@flue/runtime`、`@flue/cli`、`@flue/sdk` 等包快速构建具备上下文保持和自主决策能力的 Agent。
items.why_now: Flue 刚发布，为开发者提供构建自主 Agent 的 TypeScript 框架，支持沙箱隔离与多平台部署。
items.summary_en: Flue is an open-source agent framework by Astro that enables building autonomous AI agents in TypeScript. Its core features include built-in support for sessions, secure sandboxing (local or remote), skills, tools, subagents, and native integrations with Slack, GitHub, and observability platforms. Deployable on Node.js, Cloudflare Workers, or CI/CD runners, its agent logic is expressed via a composable `@flue/runtime` harness with example setups for triaging issues or using databases.

items.title: Kilo-Org/kilocode
items.summary: Kilo Code 是一款开源 AI 编程代理，支持在 VS Code、JetBrains 和 CLI 中使用，提供 500+ 种模型（如 GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.7 等）且按提供商原价计费，无需 API 密钥即可开始。它包含 Code、Plan、Ask、Debug、Review 五种专用代理，支持自然语言生成代码、内联自动补全、终端与浏览器控制及 MCP 服务器扩展，并可通过 `kilo run --auto` 实现 CI/CD 全自主运行。用户可通过 npm、curl、Homebrew 等方式安装 CLI，或直接使用云端版本（app.kilo.ai/cloud）。
items.why_now: Kilo Code 刚上线，支持 500+ 主流模型零加价，且无需 API 密钥即可免费开始。
items.summary_en: Kilo Code is an open source AI coding agent available in VS Code, JetBrains, CLI, and cloud (app.kilo.ai), supporting 500+ models including GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview at provider pricing with zero markup. It offers specialized agents (Code, Plan, Ask, Debug, Review), inline autocomplete, terminal/browser control, an MCP marketplace, and an autonomous CI/CD mode via `kilo run --auto`. No API keys are required to start, and installation is supported across Windows, macOS, and Linux via npm, Homebrew, or direct binary downloads.

items.title: Dify Agentic Workflow Platform: 5 Hidden Uses of the 145K-Star Open Source AI Stack
items.summary: Dify 是一个拥有 145,764 GitHub Stars、22,915 Forks、460+ 贡献者的开源 LLM 应用开发平台，最新 v1.14.2 版本（2026年5月）支持将工作流导出为 YAML 实现版本控制与回放，并内置多模型自动降级路由（如 GPT-4o → Claude 3.5 Sonnet → GPT-4o-mini），无需修改工作流逻辑即可实现生产级容错。
items.why_now: Dify 刚发布 v1.14.2（2026年5月），新增工作流 YAML 导出、多模型自动降级等生产级能力，145K Star 开源生态加速成熟。
items.summary_en: Dify is an open-source LLM app development platform with 145,764 GitHub stars, 22,915 forks, and 460+ contributors, shipping v1.14.2 in May 2026 with security hardening and workflow reliability improvements. Beyond its common use as a no-code chatbot builder, Dify supports five underused capabilities: exporting entire workflows as YAML for Git version control, CI testing, and step-by-step execution replay via a built-in tracing API; multi-model routing with automatic fallback chains across providers (e.g., GPT-4o → Claude 3.5 Sonnet → GPT-4o-mini) triggered by rate limits or errors; and integrated RAG pipelines, agent tool calling, and LLMOps — all deployable on self-hosted infrastructure.

items.title: Dify 的 5 个隐藏用法：14.5 万 Star 的开源 AI 工作流平台

items.why_now: Dify v1.14.2 刚发布，新增工作流可靠性改进与多模型路由能力。
items.summary_en: Dify is an open-source LLM application development platform with 145,764 GitHub Stars, 22,915 Forks, and 460+ contributors, recently releasing v1.14.2 (May 2026) with security hardening and workflow reliability improvements. The article reveals five underused capabilities: exporting workflows as YAML for Git-based version control and execution replay via tracing APIs (e.g., Langfuse, Arize Phoenix), configuring multi-model fallback chains (e.g., GPT-4o → Claude 3.5 Sonnet → GPT-4o-mini) for zero-downtime resilience, customizing RAG pipelines with hybrid search (vector + keyword) and dataset-specific chunking strategies, and more. items.title: 蔚来补上“智驾课”，任少卿总结：智驾技术创新将重构竞争
items.summary: 蔚来通过自研AI Infra（含推理引擎、部署框架及AI编译器），实现了同一套智驾代码在NT2.0、NT2.5和NT3.0三代平台共18款车型上的跨平台兼容，将模型部署时间从数天压缩至2小时内，并借助"影子模式"每周完成超4000万公里主动安全测试以高效筛选Corner Case数据。任少卿指出，2023年后智驾技术重回鼓励底层创新的"第二阶段"，蔚来据此将团队重组为"4x100米接力跑"架构，重点投入预研，推动世界模型与闭环强化学习落地，使其智驾能力在架构、数据与算法协同下实现跃升，目前基于世界模型的闭环强化学习版本在架构进度上不落后于特斯拉FSD。
items.why_now: 6月18日蔚来刚向18款车型推送世界模型，智驾能力实现跨平台统一升级
items.summary_en: NIO deployed a world model across 18 vehicles spanning three hardware platforms (NT2.0, NT2.5, NT3.0) by building a proprietary AI Infra stack since 2020, including a custom inference engine, deployment framework, and AI compiler that reduced deployment time from 1–2 weeks to 1–2 days while improving on-device inference performance by over 20%. The company uses "shadow mode" on production vehicles to run unvalidated models without interfering with drivers, automatically uploading Corner Cases where model predictions diverge from human actions, enabling over 40 million km of weekly safety testing equivalent to 1,000 test cars running year-round. NIO's CTO Ren Shaoqing restructured the autonomous driving team into a "4×100m relay" organization (research, mainline delivery, cross-platform adaptation, mass production) in 2023, betting heavily on fundamental R&D as he judged the industry had regressed from a strategy-stacking phase back to a stage rewarding bottom-up innovation with world models and closed-loop reinforcement learning.

items.title: 驾驭 Claude Code：CLAUDE.md、技能、钩子、规则、子智能体等
items.summary: Claude Code 支持七种自定义指令方式：CLAUDE.md（根目录始终加载）、规则（路径范围避免无关上下文消耗）、技能（按需调用，共享 token 预算）、子智能体（隔离并行任务）、钩子（确定性自动化如运行 linter 或备份）、输出样式（注入系统提示永不压缩）和附加系统提示（CLI 标志单次有效）。每种方式在加载时机和适用场景上各有不同，例如 CLAUDE.md 适合存放构建命令与编码规范，子智能体用于并行隔离任务，钩子绕过压缩确保确定性自动化执行。
items.why_now: 文章未提时效性信号。
items.summary_en: The article outlines seven customization methods in Claude Code: CLAUDE.md (always loaded at root, on-demand in subdirectories), rules (scoped or unscoped), skills (on-demand, shared token budget), sub-agents (isolated context execution), hooks (lifecycle-triggered, bypass compression), output styles (injected into system prompt, never compressed), and additional system prompts (CLI flag, single-use). Each method varies in loading timing, compression behavior, context cost, and use case—for example, CLAUDE.md suits build commands and coding standards, scoped rules reduce irrelevant context, sub-agents handle parallel isolated tasks, and hooks enable deterministic automation like running linters or backing up chat logs.

items.title: Vibe-coded automations are becoming a real problem and I don't think we're talking about it enough
items.summary: 随着"氛围编程"（vibe coding）式自动化开发泛滥，大量企业主雇佣的自动化专家仅关注"如何实现"而忽视"为何实现"，导致构建的自动化流程普遍存在无错误处理、逻辑偶然正确、缺乏模块化、凭证管理混乱和零文档等严重问题。作者指出，这些自动化方案在测试阶段看似正常，但一旦进入生产环境遇到字段缺失、超时或API限制等异常情况便会整体崩溃，且因缺乏治理机制（如责任人、变更流程和故障通知），系统上线三个月后常因一次小修改而悄然失效。作者强调，专业自动化开发者应优先询问业务背后的"为什么"和"谁负责"，而非仅讨论技术实现，否则最终交付的解决方案将难以维护和信任。
items.why_now: vibe-coded自动化因缺乏治理和错误处理正导致大量业务故障，问题已集中爆发。
items.summary_en: Hired automation builders often skip error handling and documentation, creating fragile workflows that fail on missing fields, timeouts, or API limits. Critical gaps include no modular structure, careless credential handling, and zero governance (ownership, break notifications, change processes). These oversights lead to broken client trust and quiet system failures after minor tweaks.

items.summary_en: Crawlie is a 100% free, open-source, local-first SEO audit tool that detects issues with traditional SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization for AI search engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity) and explains why each issue matters and how to fix it. items.title: google-research/timesfm
items.summary: TimesFM 2.5 是 Google Research 开发的解码器时序预测基础模型，参数量从 500M 精简至 200M，上下文长度从 2048 扩展至 16k，并支持通过可选的 30M 分位数头实现最长 1000 步的连续分位数预测。该模型已集成至 Google 的 BigQuery ML、Google Sheets 和 Vertex Model Garden 等产品中，同时支持通过 HuggingFace Transformers + PEFT（LoRA）进行微调，并提供 Flax 版本以加速推理。安装方式为 `pip install timesfm[torch]` 或 `pip install timesfm[flax]`，协变量支持通过 `timesfm[xreg]` 扩展实现。
items.why_now: Google Research 发布 TimesFM 2.5，支持 16k 上下文和分位数预测，并新增 LoRA 微调示例。
items.summary_en: Google Research's TimesFM is a decoder-only pretrained foundation model for time-series forecasting, with version 2.5 scaling down to 200M parameters (from 500M) while extending context support up to 16k (from 2048), removing frequency indicators, adding continuous quantile forecasting to 1000-step horizons via an optional 30M parameter head, and introducing new features including Flax inference, covariate support through XReg, example LoRA fine-tuning via PEFT, and agent skill integration.

items.title: DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp
items.summary: codebase-memory-mcp 是一款高性能代码智能 MCP 服务器，能在毫秒级索引代码库（含 Linux 内核在内 28M 千行代码仅需 3 分钟），通过 tree-sitter AST 分析和 LSP 语义解析支持 158 种语言，构建包含函数、类、调用链等信息的可视化知识图谱。与逐文件探索相比，查询 token 消耗减少 99%（120倍），工具调用减少 2.1倍，回答质量达 83%。支持一键安装部署（单静态二进制、零依赖），兼容11种主流编程代理工具，并提供3D交互界面（localhost:9749）用于图谱浏览。所有处理完全本地化，保障代码安全。
items.why_now: MCP协议刚发布即支持11个主流编码Agent，可彻底终结逐文件grep的低效代码探索模式。
items.summary_en: codebase-memory-mcp is a high-performance MCP server that indexes codebases into a persistent knowledge graph, parsing 158 languages via tree-sitter AST analysis and Hybrid LSP semantic resolution for 11 major languages. It indexes the Linux kernel (28M LOC) in 3 minutes, answers structural queries in under 1ms, reduces token usage by 99% (120× fewer tokens vs. file-by-file search), and ships as a single static binary with zero dependencies across macOS, Linux, and Windows. The tool provides 14 MCP tools for search, impact analysis, dead code detection, and cross-service HTTP linking, auto-configures 11 coding agents via a one-line install, and includes an optional 3D graph visualization UI at localhost:9749.

items.title: alibaba/zvec
items.summary: Zvec 是阿里巴巴开源的轻量级进程内向量数据库，新版本 v0.5.0 于 2026 年 6 月 12 日发布，新增全文搜索（FTS）、混合检索（融合向量、全文和结构化过滤）、磁盘索引 DiskANN 以大幅降低大批量数据内存占用，并新增 Go 和 Rust 官方 SDK、可视化工具 Zvec Studio。Zvec 原生支持稠密向量与稀疏向量混合查询，具备 WAL 持久化保证和每秒十亿级毫秒检索性能，无需服务端即可在笔记本、服务器或边缘设备运行，支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 平台。安装方式简洁（如 Python 执行 `pip install zvec`），提供一分钟快速上手示例，适合低延迟生产级相似性搜索场景。
items.why_now: Zvec 刚于2026年6月12日发布v0.5.0，新增全文检索、混合搜索和磁盘索引，并推出Go/Rust SDK，适合快速集成。
items.summary_en: Zvec is an open-source, in-process vector database developed by Alibaba Group, designed for low-latency, scalable similarity search embedded directly into applications. Version 0.5.0 (June 12, 2026) introduces native full-text search, hybrid retrieval combining vector and keyword search, a new DiskANN on-disk index for reduced memory usage, and official Go/Rust SDKs plus Zvec Studio visual tool. It supports dense and sparse vectors, multi-vector queries, write-ahead logging for durability, and runs across Linux, macOS, and Windows with Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, and Dart/Flutter SDKs.

items.title: yifanfeng97/Hyper-Extract
items.summary: Hyper-Extract 是一个基于 LLM 的知识提取框架，能将非结构化文本一键转化为多种结构化知识形式，包括知识图谱、超图和时空图等 8 种结构，内置 10+ 种提取引擎（如 GraphRAG、LightRAG）和 80+ 个覆盖金融、法律、医疗等领域的 YAML 模板。相比 GraphRAG、LightRAG 等现有方案，Hyper-Extract 是唯一同时支持时空图、超图、领域模板和多语言的工具，并可通过 `he parse` 命令或 Python API 快速调用，支持本地 vLLM 部署（如 Qwen3.5-9B + bge-m3）以保障数据隐私。
items.why_now: Hyper-Extract 刚发布，支持8种知识结构和80+领域模板，填补 GraphRAG 等工具在超图、时空图提取上的空白。
items.summary_en: Hyper-Extract is an LLM-powered CLI and Python framework that converts unstructured documents into 8 structured knowledge formats—including knowledge graphs, hypergraphs, spatio-temporal graphs, lists, sets, and Pydantic models—using one command. It offers 80+ domain-specific YAML templates (finance, legal, medical, TCM, general), 10+ extraction engines (GraphRAG, LightRAG, KG-Gen, Hyper-RAG), and supports OpenAI, Alibaba Bailian, and local vLLM deployment (e.g., Qwen3.5-9B + bge-m3) for on-premise data privacy. Users can parse documents, incrementally query the knowledge base via `he search`, and visualize results interactively, with notable differentiation from competitors through its support for spatio-temporal graphs, hypergraphs, and multi-language extraction.

items.title: Lightricks/LTX-2
items.summary: LTX-2 是 Lightricks 发布的全球首个基于 DiT 架构的音视频同步生成基础模型，将现代视频生成的所有核心能力集成于单一模型中，包括音视频同步、高保真输出、多种性能模式、生产级输出和开放 API 访问。官方提供了完整的 Python 推理与 LoRA 训练工具包，支持文本/图像生成视频（TI2Vid）、音频驱动视频生成（A2Vid）、唇形同步（LipDub）、HDR 视频转换、关键帧插值等多种 Pipeline，并可通过 FP8 量化和 FlashAttention 4 等优化手段降低显存占用、加速推理。模型提供 22B 参数蒸馏版与完整版两种 Checkpoint，配合空间/时间超分器和多个专用 LoRA（如 HDR、LipDub、运动追踪、姿态控制、摄像机控制等），可实现从快速原型到生产级输出的灵活部署。
items.why_now: 首个开源音视频同步生成DiT基座模型刚发布，可直接商用。
items.summary_en: LTX-2 is the first DiT-based audio–video foundation model to integrate synchronized audio and video generation, high fidelity, multiple performance modes, production-ready outputs, API access, and open access in a single model. The official Python package supports inference and LoRA training, with recommended pipeline **TI2VidTwoStagesPipeline** for production and **DistilledPipeline** for fastest inference (8-step stage 1, 4-step stage 2), alongside optional FP8 quantization and spatial/temporal upscalers. Specialized pipelines enable retakes, lip dubbing, keyframe interpolation, HDR output, and various LoRA controls for camera motion, pose, detail enhancement, and more.

items.title: Our cloud bill exploded after AI went live
items.summary: 2026年AI推理支出已占云基础设施的55%，预计年底达70-80%，远超训练成本。企业常因API调用量从数百激增至数百万而遭遇500%-1000%的成本估算偏差，且智能体工作流会触发大量隐性模型调用。解决方案包括：将简单任务分流至小模型、仅对复杂场景用大模型，并建立按用户/功能维度的成本监控体系。
items.why_now: 2026年推理支出首超训练，AI上线后云账单可能暴涨数倍。
items.summary_en: Our AI feature caused the cloud bill to triple overnight once deployed to real users, as inference API calls jumped from hundreds to millions per day. In early 2026, inference spend overtook training spend, now accounting for 55% of AI cloud infrastructure (up from ~30% three years ago), with analysts projecting 70–80% by year-end. Gartner reports cost estimation errors of 500–1000% at scale, and agentic workflows worsen the problem by firing up to 20 hidden model calls per user interaction. The fix: route simple tasks to smaller, cheaper models, reserve large models for complex cases, and build cost observability per user, feature, and endpoint.

items.title: Salesforce CodeGen教程：生成、验证并重排序Python函数（含单元测试与安全检查）

items.why_now: CodeGen25-7B刚发布，可本地部署的代码生成能力首次达到商用门槛。
items.summary_en: This tutorial implements an end-to-end code generation workflow using Salesforce CodeGen models (350M, 2B, codegen2-1B, codegen25-7B) loaded from HuggingFace. It generates Python functions from natural language prompts, then applies function extraction, syntax checking, static security analysis, unit test validation, best-of-N candidate re-ranking, and multi-step program synthesis. The pipeline demonstrates CodeGen's ability to not only complete code but also evaluate, filter, and organize generated results, with benchmark visualization and export capabilities included.

items.title: MosaicLeaks： 你的研究智能体能保守秘密吗？

items.why_now: 文章未提及具体发布时间或时效性事件，输出
items.summary_en: MosaicLeaks introduces a new task of 1,001 multi-hop research chains mixing private local documents and public web queries, revealing that deep research agents frequently leak private information—and that optimizing task performance alone worsens leakage. The study proposes Privacy-Aware Deep Research (PA-DR), a reinforcement learning training method that raises strict chain success rate from 48.7% to 58.7% while reducing answer/full-information leakage from 34.0% to 9.9%.

items.title: Anthropic Project Fetch 第二阶段：Claude Opus 4.7 自主完成任务，速度比人类团队快约20倍

items.why_now: Anthropic刚发布Claude Opus 4.7，实现全自主机器人任务，速度超人类20倍。
items.summary_en: Anthropic's Project Fetch Phase 2 results show Claude Opus 4.7 completing all tasks autonomously—no human assistance—at roughly 20× the speed of the fastest human team and over 37× faster than teams without Claude, while writing nearly 10× less code. The model excelled at sensor integration and path planning but struggled with closed-loop control tasks like precisely moving a beach ball. These gains stem from scaling general-purpose models rather than robotics-specific optimization.

items.title: Datasette Apps: Host custom HTML applications inside Datasette

items.summary_en: Datasette Apps are a new plugin for the Datasette project that allows hosting custom, self-contained HTML+JavaScript applications within a tightly constrained `<iframe>` sandbox. This sandbox mechanism leverages a dual-security approach using `sandbox` attributes and an immutable Content Security Policy to prevent untrusted code from accessing the parent DOM, cookies, \localStorage, or making unauthorized external requests. The applications can interact with the Datasette backend via SQL queries (both read-only and configured write queries) and \code{fetch()} through the use of secure communication channels like \code{postMessage()} and \code{MessageChannel}.

items.title: The Professor of Outputmaxxing — Anjney Midha, AMP
items.summary: 当前AI扩展的核心瓶颈不是GPU数量，而是极低的计算效率——前沿实验室xAI的MFU（模型浮点利用率）不足10%，而行业领先水平已达60-70%。Anjney Midha（AMP创始人）指出，真正的挑战在于系统设计：调度、网络、内核、数据管道等复杂的系统决策决定了理论FLOPs能否转化为实际训练进展，这正是AMP构建独立算力网格以"让FLOPs像兆瓦级电力一样流动"的核心理念。他还强调，AI数据中心面临社区反对和电网限制，未来需采用类似"独立系统运营商"的模式，并推动算力市场向更开放、高效和负责任的方向发展。
items.summary_en: The article criticizes the industry focus on acquiring more GPUs, noting that most labs—including xAI—suffer from low Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU), often below 10%, while best-in-class systems reach 60–70%. It features Anjney Midha arguing that the real AI scaling challenge is systemic efficiency across scheduling, networking, and parallelism rather than sheer CapEx. Midha advocates for full-stack optimization ("output maxing") and promoted AMP’s compute grid vision and SF Compute protocol for more efficient, marketplace-driven resource allocation.

items.title: The hard part of national ID OCR isn't the OCR
items.summary: 各国身份证OCR的核心难点并非识别文字本身，而是字段、书写体系和日期/号码格式的跨国家差异。例如，泰国身份证使用佛历（比公历多543年）和泰文数字，中国身份证为18位号码，德国证件包含身高和瞳色等非通用字段，直接映射单一固定模型会丢失关键字段或产生空值。建议为每个国家建立独立的解析层：保留原文（包括非拉丁字符原文与可能的拉丁转写），区分OCR提取与自校验逻辑（如校验位或日期归一化），而非依赖通用OCR直接输出标准格式。
items.summary_en: The core challenge in national ID OCR isn't text extraction—it's handling per-country variation in fields (e.g., Thai IDs include religion, German IDs include height/eye color), scripts (native vs. Latin, requiring dual preservation for KYC accuracy), and formats (Thai Buddhist calendar dates offset by +543 years, structured ID numbers with checksums). A fixed schema fails; instead, the data model must treat field sets as country-dependent, preserve native-script names alongside Latin transliterations when present, and normalize dates/IDs per local rules (e.g., convert Thai numerals, subtract 543, output ISO 8601). Implementation requires either building per-country parsing logic on top of generic OCR or using a pre-trained multi-country ID model that natively handles these axes.

**摘要：**

BilibiliWorld 2026将于2026年7月10日至12日在上海国家会展中心举办，首次在超过190个国家和地区同步开票，成为国内首个面向海外售票的综合性ACG展会。商务部等八部门发布《关于加快"人工智能+消费"发展的实施意见》，围绕商品消费、服务消费等五方面提出17项举措，推动AI进千家万户、进千商万店，涵盖智能终端供给、人形机器人消费赛道、"人车家"全场景联动生态等。此外，快舟十一号遥十三运载火箭于6月17日在酒泉卫星发射中心成功发射，将微厘空间05组卫星送入预定轨道；曹操出行宣布全面布局Robovan领域，计划到2030年累计投放10万辆自动驾驶货运车；滴滴自动驾驶已实现L4级全栈核心技术自主可控，新一代Robotaxi车型R2已在广州、北京开展全天候载客测试。
items.summary_en: BilibiliWorld 2026 becomes China's first comprehensive ACG exhibition to sell tickets overseas, with global simultaneous ticket sales across 190+ countries starting June 20, 2026, for the July 10–12 event in Shanghai. Didi Autonomous Driving showcased its L4 self-driving technology and new Robotaxi model R2 at London's MOVE 2026, while CaoCao Mobility announced plans to deploy 100,000 autonomous freight vehicles (Robovans) by 2030. China's Ministry of Commerce and seven other departments released 17 measures to advance "AI+consumption," promoting smart terminals, humanoid robots, and AI integration across home, elderly care, and tourism sectors.

items.title: 亚马逊员工遭公司内部调查，曾公开批评数据中心扩张
items.summary: 五名亚马逊工程师公开批评公司激进扩张AI数据中心并呼吁政府监管后，遭到公司内部调查。此前五人曾在西雅图市议会听证会上作证支持暂停新建数据中心政策，该市议会已于6月9日全票通过为期一年的建设禁令。
items.summary_en: Amazon engineers who publicly criticized the company's aggressive AI data center expansion and called for government regulation are now under internal investigation. Five Amazon employees testified at a Seattle City Council hearing on a proposed one-year moratorium on new large data center construction, which the council unanimously passed on June 9.

items.title: 因AI安全隐患遭监管，Anthropic承诺加强与美政府沟通
items.summary: Anthropic因AI安全隐患遭美国监管整治，涉及高性能模型"Mythos"与"Fable"。公司向商务部长卢特尼克提交方案，承诺与白宫深化合作以消除安全风险。目前双方仍在整改磋商中，Anthropic计划未来更快处置安全风险。
items.summary_en: Anthropic executives submitted a proposal to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick pledging deeper cooperation with the White House to quickly resolve safety concerns that had triggered regulatory crackdowns on its high-performance models Mythos and Fable; the two sides remain in active remediation talks.

items.title: 2026 最强智能眼镜发布，但「iPhone 时刻」还没到来
items.summary: 2026年6月16日，Google与Xreal联合发布了全球首款搭载Android XR系统和高通骁龙Reality Elite芯片的XR眼镜Xreal Aura，采用分体式双芯片架构（骁龙Reality Elite+X1S），重95克，拥有70度大视场角，支持镜腿操作与十指手势输入，并内置Gemini AI多模态助手，首秋在北美日韩等地上市，价格暂未公布。同日Snap推出一体化AR眼镜SPECS（132至136克，51度视场角，续航4小时），搭载自研Snap OS，售价2195美元，面向开发者和科技爱好者。高通骁龙Reality Elite相较上代GPU提升60%、CPU提升30%、NPU提升160%，续航提升20%，为XR眼镜带来统一的Android生态拐点，但距大规模普及的“iPhone时刻”仍未到来。
items.summary_en: Xreal Aura, the first XR glasses running Android XR and powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon Reality Elite chip, launched with a 70-degree field of view, 95g weight, and dual-chip architecture (Reality Elite + X1S), offering access to millions of Android apps and advanced Gemini AI multimodal capabilities, with pre-orders open at $99 deposit for a fall 2026 release in the US, UK, Japan, Canada, and Korea. On the same day, Snap released SPECS, a fully integrated standalone AR glasses weighing 132–136g with a 47-degree FOV, 4-hour battery life, custom Snap OS, and AI-powered contextual features, priced at $2,195 targeting developers and tech enthusiasts. Qualcomm's new Snapdragon Reality Elite delivers 60% higher GPU, 30% higher CPU, and 160% higher NPU performance over its predecessor, alongside 20% better battery efficiency, marking a pivotal "Android moment" for the XR industry with unified hardware and software platforms—though the "iPhone moment" for mass adoption has not yet arrived.

items.title: OpenAI IPO前连下两城：招揽Transformer共同作者及前白宫AI政策官员
items.summary: OpenAI在IPO前夕重磅招募两位关键人物：Google Transformer共同作者Noam Shazeer及前白宫AI政策官员Dean Ball，Ball将于7月6日领导新成立的Strategic Futures团队，聚焦灾难性风险、劳动力市场影响等前沿AI治理议题。此举背景正值Anthropic因美国出口管制相继下架Fable 5和Mythos 5模型的特殊时期。
items.summary_en: OpenAI hired two key figures ahead of its IPO: Noam Shazeer, co-author of the Transformer architecture who previously returned to Google DeepMind via a $2.7B acquisition, and former White House AI policy official Dean Ball, who joins July 6 to lead a new Strategic Futures team reporting to CSO Jason Kwon. The team will focus on catastrophic risk, recursive self-improvement, labor market impacts, and government relations. The moves come as Anthropic was forced to pull its Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models due to U.S. export control restrictions.

items.title: 这家韩国电信巨头是Anthropic"Mythos"争议的焦点
items.summary: Anthropic最强AI模型Claude Mythos因向韩国电信巨头SK Telecom开放访问权限而遭美国政府出口管制，导火索是美方担忧SK Telecom与中国存在关联。亚马逊随后向白宫报告Mythos公开版本Fable 5存在可被绕过的安全漏洞，白宫最终命令Anthropic撤销所有外国用户对Mythos和Fable 5的访问权限，Anthropic因此完全禁用这两个模型。SK Telecom此前向Anthropic投资1亿美元，并通过Project Glasswing项目获得访问权，其所属SK集团在华业务广泛，曾与中国联通有过合资历史。
items.summary_en: The US government imposed export controls on Anthropic's most powerful AI model, Claude Mythos, after Anthropic granted access to South Korean telecom giant SK Telecom, which the US believes has ties to China. Following reports from Amazon that Fable 5, the public version of Mythos, had bypassable safety vulnerabilities, the White House ordered Anthropic to revoke access for all foreign nationals, leading to a complete shutdown of both models. SK Telecom had invested $100 million in Anthropic and recently gained access to Mythos through Project Glasswing, serving 150 organizations, scrutiny intensified because SK Group's extensive history in China, including a past joint venture with China Unicom, despite SK Telecom's small China revenue of approximately $1.9 million in 2024.

items.title: OpenAI 强化学习实现广泛且持久的有益模型
items.summary: OpenAI 利用强化学习在真实对话场景中训练模型，覆盖健康、教育、科学、法律、工程等多个领域，使模型展现出诚实、认知谦逊、元认知透明、可纠正性、普遍公平性等有益特质。训练后模型在数十项独立对齐评测（包括奖励黑客、欺骗、有害建议、规范遵从等）上均表现提升，且改善效果可泛化到未参与训练的领域、任务和评分设定。即使在对抗性提示或微调下，模型仍难以被导向有害行为，表明该方法能产生广泛且持久的对齐泛化。
items.summary_en: OpenAI used reinforcement learning to train models exhibiting beneficial traits—honesty, intellectual humility, metacognitive transparency, correctability, universal fairness, and care for human well-being—across domains including health, education, science, law, and engineering. The trained models improved on dozens of independent alignment benchmarks covering reward hacking, deception, harmful advice, and norm compliance, with gains generalizing to unseen domains, tasks, and scoring setups. The improvements proved robust against adversarial prompting and fine-tuning, demonstrating broad and durable alignment generalization.

items.title: 伯尼·桑德斯提出7万亿美元AI计划：对大型AI公司征收50%股票税
items.summary: 伯尼·桑德斯提出一项立法，拟对年AI销售额超过2亿美元的大型AI公司征收50%的股票税，以此建立价值约7万亿美元的主权财富基金。该基金计划每年向每位美国公民发放超过1000美元股息（按5%年股息率计算），并将资金用于资助医疗、教育和住房等公共事业。法案还提议成立由总统提名、参议院确认的两党"民主AI独立委员会"，通过持有投票权来阻止AI公司损害公共利益，同时要求AI公司剥离非AI业务，但该计划面临共和党国会和特朗普政府的阻力。
items.summary_en: Senators Bernie Sanders has proposed legislation imposing a 50% stock tax on large AI companies with annual AI sales exceeding $200 million, aiming to establish a $7 trillion sovereign wealth fund. The fund would pay every U.S. citizen over $1,000 in annual dividends (5% annual yield) and finance healthcare, education, and housing, while requiring AI firms to spin off non-AI businesses. A bipartisan "Democratic AI Independent Commission," appointed by the President and confirmed by the Senate, would hold voting rights to block companies from harming public interests, though the bill faces resistance from the Republican Congress and Trump administration.

items.title: AI数据中心获政府强制电网快车道
items.summary: 美国联邦能源监管委员会（FERC）强制六大电网运营商为数据中心等大型用户提供快速并网通道，并要求其在30天内报告剩余发电容量、60天内审查区域电价，同时数据中心需承担并网费用。尽管该指令未解决发电容量短缺问题，但数据中心电力需求预计到2035年将增长近三倍，而部分地区批发电价已较五年前上涨267%。
items.summary_en: FERC ordered six major U.S. grid operators to provide fast-track interconnection for data centers, requiring them to cover grid connection costs, while mandating consideration of alternative transmission technologies and reporting on generation capacity within 30 days and regional pricing within 60 days. Data center power demand is projected to nearly triple by 2035, a stark contrast to historically flat demand growth, with wholesale electricity prices in some regions surging 267% over five years per Bloomberg. The order does not address the underlying generation capacity shortage.

items.title: 我国首部L3/L4自动驾驶强制性国标公示：2027年7月起实施
items.summary: 工信部6月16日公示我国首部针对L3/L4自动驾驶的强制性国标《智能网联汽车自动驾驶系统安全要求》，建议2027年7月1日起实施，要求系统安全水平至少达到"合格且专注驾驶人"，引入Safety Case机制，其中L3重点规范人机交接、L4强调自身风险处置且不得依赖远程协助，新申请车型实施日起执行、已获批车型享约一年过渡期。
items.summary_en: China's MIIT published the country's first mandatory national standards for L3/L4 autonomous driving systems on June 16, with a public comment period through June 24 and a proposed effective date of July 1, 2027. The standards require L3 systems to achieve a safety level equivalent to a "qualified and attentive driver" with a Safety Case mechanism, focusing on human-machine handover for L3 and mandating independent risk handling without reliance on remote assistance for L4. New vehicle models must comply from the effective date, while already-approved models receive approximately a one-year transition period.

items.title: Adobe 为 Photoshop、Premiere 等多款 Creative Cloud 应用加入 AI 智能体
items.summary: Adobe 将 AI Assistant 创意智能体以公开测试形式扩展至 Photoshop、Premiere、Illustrator 和 InDesign 等多款 Creative Cloud 应用，可自动完成 Premiere 分拣素材与粗剪、Photoshop 换背景、Illustrator 批量生成文件、InDesign 更新版式等多步骤常规任务；Firefly 同步新增面向个人创作者的品牌套件、产品图转短视频及 Quick Cut 自动剪辑功能。Adobe 工具已集成至 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Microsoft 365 Copilot，与 Google Gemini 及 Slack 的集成也即将上线。
items.summary_en: Adobe has expanded its AI-powered "Creative Agents" across Photoshop, Premiere, and other Creative Cloud apps, offering an AI Assistant that automates multi-step tasks like organizing and rough-cutting footage in Premiere and swapping backgrounds in Photoshop. Firefly introduces new features including brand kits, product-image-to-short-video conversion, and Quick Cut auto-editing. Adobe tools are already integrated with ChatGPT, Claude, and Microsoft 365 Copilot, with upcoming support for Google Gemini and Slack.

items.title: GPT-5.5 Instant提升ChatGPT健康智能
items.summary: ChatGPT每周有超过2.3亿用户获取健康信息，GPT-5.5 Instant在健康评估中表现显著提升，达到前沿Thinking模型水平，已面向所有免费用户开放。基于HealthBench和HealthBench Professional评估，其回复在准确性、安全性和沟通质量上优于医生手写回复及早期模型，故障模式发生率更低。近两个月生产流量显示，健康类回复事实性问题率下降71%。
items.summary_en: GPT-5.5 Instant significantly improves ChatGPT's health intelligence, now available to all free users. On challenging health evaluations, it matches frontier Thinking models, with responses outperforming doctor-written answers and earlier models in accuracy, safety, and communication quality on HealthBench benchmarks. Over the past two months, factual error rates in health responses dropped by 71%.

items.title: 火山引擎上线豆包实时语音模型3.0 API 服务，开启邀测
items.summary: 火山引擎上线豆包实时语音模型3.0（Seeduplex）API 服务并开启邀测，该模型为原生全双工端到端语音大模型，支持多人对话中安静待命、指定话题主动加入，并可通过自定义工具完成日历预定、邮件发送等实时任务。模型误回复率与误打断率大幅降低，判停延迟缩短约250ms，复杂场景抢话比例下降40%，用户主动打断延迟缩短约300ms。适用于汽车智能座舱、智能硬件、智能客服等场景。
items.summary_en: 火山引擎上线豆包实时语音模型3.0（Seeduplex）API服务并开启邀测。该原生全双工端到端语音大模型具备精准遵循、抗干扰、动态判停三大优势，误回复率与误打断率大幅降低，判停延迟缩短约250ms，复杂场景抢话比例下降40%，用户主动打断延迟缩短约300ms。支持通过自定义工具在实时交互中完成预定日历、发送邮件等任务，适用于汽车智能座舱、智能硬件、智能客服等场景。

items.title: 八部门：用好个人消费贷款财政贴息政策，支持消费者购买 AI 相关产品
items.summary: 商务部等八部门6月18日发布《关于加快"人工智能+消费"发展的实施意见》，明确通过个人消费贷款财政贴息及以旧换新补贴，重点支持AI手机、智能电脑、AI眼镜、智能网联汽车、人形机器人等新一代智能终端消费，并加快AI在居家养老、文化旅游、住宿餐饮等场景的应用落地。
items.summary_en: On June 18, eight Chinese ministries including the Ministry of Commerce jointly issued an implementation opinion on accelerating "AI + consumer" development, directing fiscal funds to support consumer purchases of AI-related products. The policy prioritizes subsidizing next-generation smart terminals—including AI phones, smart PCs, smart TVs, smart homes, AI glasses, smart connected vehicles, and humanoid robots—within the consumer goods trade-in framework. It also calls for expanding AI applications in home services, elderly care, cultural tourism, hospitality, dining, and education, while establishing AI product launch platforms and promoting "AI in Every Home" campaigns.

items.title: OpenAI与哈佛等合作研究：o3 Deep Research模型辅助诊断儿童罕见病，额外诊断率4.8%
items.summary: 波士顿儿童医院、哈佛大学与OpenAI合作，利用o3 Deep Research推理模型对376例未确诊的罕见病儿童病例进行重新分析，经专家评审和临床确认后，在18例中成功建立诊断，额外诊断率达4.8%。该AI辅助工作流通过生成基于证据的候选假设，帮助专家在未解病例中发现可检验的诊断方向，使定期再分析未确诊病例具备更强的可扩展性，但模型本身不直接做出临床决策，仅提供证据链供专家审查。
items.summary_en: OpenAI collaborated with Boston Children's Hospital and Harvard University to evaluate the o3 Deep Research model’s ability to aid in diagnosing pediatric rare diseases, with results published in *NEJM AI*. After reanalyzing 376 previously undiagnosed rare disease cases, the AI-generated evidence-backed hypotheses led to new diagnoses in 18 cases following expert review, additional testing, and clinical confirmation—a 4.8% incremental diagnostic yield. The study demonstrates that AI-assisted workflows can scalably generate testable hypotheses for unresolved cases, with the model providing interpretable evidence chains for physician review rather than making clinical decisions.

items.title: The first big exit in AI
items.summary: SpaceX 以 600 亿美元全股票交易收购 Cursor，Cursor 在 Compile 大会上还发布了代码托管平台 Origin 并预告了超越编码能力的新模型。OpenAI 2025 年审计财务数据显示收入 130.7 亿美元、成本 340 亿美元，同时 Google Gemini 联合负责人 Noam Shazeer 加入 OpenAI。此外，Shopify 推出 Spring '26 版本，允许开发者通过 Catalog API 和 Universal Commerce Protocol 构建端到端智能商务体验。
items.summary_en: SpaceX is acquiring AI coding assistant Cursor in a $60 billion all-stock deal, marking the largest AI exit to date. Cursor also announced Origin, a GitHub alternative in waitlist form, and teased a model that extends beyond coding. Separately, OpenAI's leaked 2025 financials reveal $13.07B revenue against $34B costs, highlighting ongoing heavy expenditures.

items.title: Google workspace threatening to block firefox access
items.summary: Google Workspace 近期发出威胁，计划阻止 Firefox 浏览器对 Google 产品的访问权限。此举或将对依赖 Firefox 进行办公的用户造成直接影响，意在推动竞争对手用户转向 Chrome 浏览器和更Chrome生态产品。
items.summary_en: Google Workspace is threatening to block Firefox access, potentially impacting users who rely on the browser for productivity tools. This move could force organizations and individuals to switch to Google Chrome or other supported browsers. The decision highlights ongoing tensions between browser compatibility and enterprise software ecosystems.

items.title: Amazon hopes to challenge Nvidia more directly by selling its AI chips
items.summary: 亚马逊AWS正与其他数据中心洽谈出售自研AI芯片，CEO Andy Jassy表示这将是一个价值500亿美元的商业机会，旨在更直接地挑战英伟达在AI芯片市场的主导地位。
items.summary_en: AWS is negotiating to sell its AI chips to third-party data centers, a move CEO Andy Jassy estimates could represent a $50 billion revenue opportunity. This expansion would allow Amazon to compete more directly with Nvidia in the AI chip market.

items.title: 玩了一天AI支付宝，张嘴就能点麦当劳、收能量，超级App开始卷Agent OS了
items.summary: AI 支付宝开启内测，推出 AI 助手「阿宝」，用户可通过对话直接调用麦当劳、高德打车、蚂蚁森林等小程序完成点餐、打车、收能量等操作，实现一句话办事。阿宝还能基于用户账单分析恩格尔系数、消费习惯，并支持一句话记账和资产监控，将支付宝的生活服务生态封装为可调用的 Skill。超级 App 正从服务聚合平台转向 Agent OS，支付宝通过 AI 接管小程序操作，微信则推出 AI 专属卡赋予 Agent 支付权限，行业竞争焦点正转向 Skill 生态的丰富度。
items.summary_en: Chinese Alipay launched an internal testing version "AI Alipay", allowing users to access new AI features by entering an invite code in the search bar. The centerpiece of this update is "Abao", an AI assistant that can autonomously execute tasks (ordering McDonald's via mini-programs, collecting virtual energy in Ant Forest, booking train tickets) within the app. Other key features include a smart financial management tool that analyzes spending based on user consumption data and automatically books non-platform expenses. It's part of a broader trend where super apps like Alipay are transforming their existing service ecosystems into Agent OS, with mini-programs evolving from manual click-to-enter interfaces into interactive Skills that AI agents can invoke.

items.title: Claude Enterprise 推出企业托管 MCP 连接器授权管理
items.summary: Claude Enterprise 推出企业托管 MCP 连接器授权管理功能，管理员可通过 Okta 等身份提供商为整个组织统一配置 MCP 连接器，用户首次登录即自动授权，实现零接触设置。该功能基于 Model Context Protocol 的 Enterprise-Managed Authorization 扩展构建，支持 Asana、Atlassian、Canva、Figma、Granola、Linear、Supabase 等主流 MCP 提供商，Slack 即将上线。授权管理深度集成现有 IdP 工作流，支持按组限定范围、快速撤销授权，并可要求连接器仅通过 IdP 连接以隔离工作与个人使用。
items.summary_en: Claude Enterprise now supports organization-wide MCP connector authorization managed through identity providers, starting with Okta, enabling zero-touch setup for users who are automatically provisioned upon first login. This built on the Model Context Protocol's Enterprise-Managed Authorization extension covers connectors for Asana, Atlassian, Canva, Figma, Granola, Linear, and Supabase, with Slack coming soon. Admins can scope access by group, quickly revoke authorization through the IdP, and require all connectors to connect exclusively via the IdP to separate work and personal use.

items.title: 皮尤民调：63%美国人认为AI发展太快，ChatGPT使用率翻番
items.summary: 皮尤研究中心最新民调显示，63%美国人认为AI发展速度过快，ChatGPT使用率较2023年翻番，44%受访者曾使用。青年群体使用率更高但更悲观：18-29岁中66%用过，48%认为有负面影响，仅14%看好；30-49岁中34%每天至少使用一次。约四成用AI处理工作，30%认为提高效率，28%认为帮助获取信息，66%成年人担心AI传播错误信息。

items.title: n0-computer/iroh
items.summary: Iroh 是一个用 Rust 编写的模块化网络栈，允许开发者通过公钥（而非 IP 地址）建立连接，自动选择最优路径并支持 NAT 打洞，失败时可回退到公共中继服务器。其底层基于 QUIC 协议（通过 noq 实现），提供认证加密、并发流优先级、无队头阻塞等特性，并内置 iroh-blobs（基于 BLAKE3 的内容寻址大文件传输）、iroh-gossip（可扩展的发布-订阅网络）和 iroh-docs（最终一致性键值存储）等可组合协议。用户可通过 `cargo add iroh` 快速集成，使用 `Endpoint::bind()` 和 `connect(addr, ALPN)` 等 API 实现端到端通信，同时支持通过 iroh-ffi 调用其他语言。
items.summary_en: Iroh is a modular networking stack in Rust that enables dialing by public key instead of IP addresses, automatically establishing the fastest connection via hole-punching or falling back to public relay servers. Built on QUIC through the noq library, it provides authenticated encryption, concurrent streams, and datagram transport, with pre-built protocols including iroh-blobs for BLAKE3-based content-addressed blob transfer, iroh-gossip for publish-subscribe overlay networks, and iroh-docs for eventually-consistent key-value storage. The core library can be installed via `cargo add iroh`, with FFI bindings available through iroh-ffi for non-Rust languages.

directions.name: WorkflowYAML
directions.description: A Git-native version control and diff tool for Dify agentic workflows, enabling teams to track, review, and rollback AI workflow changes like code.
directions.target_user: Small AI dev teams and solo founders using Dify to build production agentic workflows who need version control and collaboration.
core_features: Visual YAML diff viewer for Dify workflow exports with side-by-side comparison
One-click rollback to any previous workflow version with changelog
Git integration that auto-commits workflow YAML on each Dify export
directions.why_now: Dify v1.14.2 (May 2026) just introduced YAML export for workflows with version control and replay capabilities, and agent workflows are a cross-source trending topic covered by 3 separate sources. The 145K+ GitHub stars and 460+ contributors signal massive adoption, yet no dedicated Git-layer tool exists for non-technical workflow authors to manage versions. Community discussions on DEV Community highlight demand for production-grade workflow management beyond Dify's built-in features.
directions.monetization: Freemium SaaS: free for public repos, $19/mo for private repos and team collaboration features; enterprise self-hosted license at $99/mo
directions.source_article: Dify Agentic Workflow Platform: 5 Hidden Uses of the 145K-Star Open Source AI Stack

directions.name: FailoverRouter
directions.description: A plug-and-play multi-model failover middleware that sits between any LLM app and model providers, offering configurable degradation chains with sub-second health checks.
directions.target_user: Indie developers and small teams building LLM-powered products who need production reliability without vendor lock-in.
core_features: Configurable multi-model degradation chains (e.g., GPT-4o → Claude 3.5 Sonnet → GPT-4o-mini) with YAML config
Real-time latency and cost dashboard per model provider
Automatic failover with <500ms switchover and request retry logic
directions.why_now: Dify v1.14.2's built-in multi-model auto-degradation routing (GPT-4o → Claude 3.5 Sonnet → GPT-4o-mini) is one of its highlighted features, proving demand for model-agnostic failover. Agent workflows are trending across 3 independent sources. However, Dify's solution is locked inside its platform — developers using LangChain, custom code, or other frameworks have no equivalent lightweight middleware. The 22,915 forks indicate developers are actively extending Dify, suggesting a market for standalone routing components.
directions.monetization: Usage-based pricing: free up to 10K requests/mo, then $0.001 per routed request; premium tier with custom model endpoints at $49/mo
directions.source_article: Dify 的 5 个隐藏用法：14.5 万 Star 的开源 AI 工作流平台
